claim: Stock lockdown is two independent layers — a firmware Gen lock plus missing AC coupling capacitors on 12 of 16 lanes — and the capacitor mod and Gen2 unlock each solve one layer, neither replacing the other.
stance_target: why 'Gen2 x4' is the realistic ceiling without physical board modification, which is the premise the repo's communication arithmetic rests on
scope_conditions: CMP 170HX PCB, 12 of 16 lanes missing AC coupling capacitors; procedure documented at modifications/pcie-capacitor-mod/
quoted_support: Stock lockdown is two independent layers: firmware Gen lock, plus missing AC coupling capacitors on **12 of 16** lanes. Capacitor mod and Gen2 unlock each solve one layer. Neither replaces the other.
